• What is beauty drip?
  • Advantages and disadvantages of beauty drips
  • Almost no side effects or downtime
  • Types and effects of beauty drips performed at our hospital
  • Those who cannot receive treatment
  • Risks and side effects
  • Cost of beauty infusion performed at our hospital

What is beauty drip?

Depending on your concerns, vitamins and minerals will be administered intravenously.
It is absorbed faster and more reliably than food, supplements, or topical medicines, so it has excellent immediate effects.
For example, when vitamin C is taken orally, it oxidizes before its blood concentration increases. On the other hand, with intravenous administration, the vitamin C concentration in the blood can be increased before it is oxidized because it is injected directly into the blood.
Depending on the vitamins and minerals you choose, you can expect not only beauty effects, but also fatigue recovery effects and diet effects. Another appeal of beauty infusions is that you can receive infusions that suit your goals.

Advantages and disadvantages of beauty drips

Advantage: Immediate effect

Because it is administered intravenously as an infusion, it can be expected to be highly effective. Also, with injections, there is a limit to the amount of medicine that can be injected, but with IV drips, it is possible to take more of the drug into the body over time.

Disadvantages: Requires regular vaccinations

In most cases, the effects of beauty infusions can be felt from immediately after administration until the next morning. However, in order to maintain its effectiveness, you will need to receive regular infusions.
We recommend that you check the effect by using it once a week at first, and then switch to once a month and continue.

Almost no side effects or downtime

Side effects include a tingling pain when the needle is inserted and temporary internal bleeding in the affected area.
There is also almost no downtime.

Types and effects of beauty drips performed at our hospital

High concentration vitamin C

As the name suggests, it administers high concentrations of vitamin C. Many people may be familiar with the name "high-concentration vitamin C drip."
Vitamin C has been recognized not only for its beauty effects but also for its ability to improve immunity against diseases including cancer. You can take in tens of times more vitamin C into your body in a short time than with regular IV drips.

Main effect
  • High antioxidant effect
  • Suppression of melanin pigment production
  • Improves skin's moisturizing ability
  • fatigue recovery
  • aging care
  • Promotion of anti-stress hormone secretion
  • Strengthen immunity

Beautiful skin drip

This is a drug drip containing vitamin C, pantothenic acid that maintains skin and hair health, biotin that promotes skin and mucous membrane health, and alpha-lipoic acid that activates turnover.
By activating skin cells and improving metabolism, you can regain clear and fresh skin.

Main effect
  • Activation of skin cells
  • Improved metabolism
  • Improvement of age spots, freckles, and pimples
  • Improvement of skin sagging and wrinkles
  • Improving skin moisturizing power

acne drip

A drug containing B vitamins, pantothenic acid, and vitamin C is injected into the infusion.
It is expected to prevent and improve acne by normalizing skin turnover and sebum secretion, and alleviating stress. It also promotes collagen production, which can improve acne scars.

Main effect
  • Normalization of skin turnover
  • Normalization of sebum secretion
  • Prevention and improvement of acne
  • Improvement of acne scars

Shiratama drip

A drug containing glutathione as its main ingredient will be injected. Glutathione is a substance composed of three types of amino acids and has a powerful antioxidant effect. You can expect a variety of effects, including skin beautification, anti-aging care, and fatigue recovery.

Main effect
  • Beautiful skin effect
  • skin aging care
  • fatigue recovery
  • Hangover improvement
  • Improving liver function
  • Suppression of increase in active oxygen
  • Suppression of melanin pigment production

garlic injection

This is an injection whose main ingredient is vitamin B1, which is effective for beauty and recovery from fatigue. You can also expect improved metabolism and diet effects.

Main effect
  • Speedy recovery from fatigue
  • Improvement of rough skin, skin beautification effect
  • Cell activation
  • Improved metabolism
  • Improvement of sensitivity to cold
  • Hangover improvement
  • cold prevention

placenta injection

Placenta, which has active ingredients extracted from human placenta, is administered by injection. The rich nutrients contained in the placenta and ingredients that activate stem cells promote cell production.
It can be expected to have a wide range of effects, including full-body anti-aging effects and improving women's concerns such as menopause.

Main effect
  • Improvement of dry skin and rough skin
  • Aging care effect that prevents skin aging
  • Anti-aging effect on the whole body due to active oxygen removal effect
  • fatigue recovery
  • Promote blood circulation
  • Improving liver function

hangover drip

This is an intravenous drip that reduces damage to the liver caused by alcohol. By normalizing liver function, you can also expect beautiful skin effects.

Main effect
  • Improving liver function
  • fatigue recovery
  • Detoxification
  • Inhibition of melanin production
  • Beautiful skin effect

Stem cell culture supernatant liquid

The supernatant obtained by culturing the mesenchymal cells that exist in our bodies, extracting stem cells from them, and sterilizing them is called "stem cell culture supernatant." By administering this stem cell culture supernatant liquid intravenously, it promotes the restoration of the functions of tissues and cells that have been damaged in the body.
At our hospital, you can choose from two types of administration of stem cell culture solution: water photo injection and subcutaneous injection.

Main effect
  • Improvement of wrinkles and sagging
  • Improvement of stains
  • Restores skin elasticity and firmness
  • Normalization of skin turnover
  • Skin aging care effect
  • Accelerates scar healing

Exosome (stem cell culture supernatant) drip

Exosome drip (derived from deciduous dental pulp/derived from concentrated fat/stem cell culture supernatant) is a treatment that injects cytokines (growth factors), amino acids, vitamins, etc., which are said to be necessary for the growth and repair of various cells in the body, directly into the blood via drip. The treatment can be expected to have effects such as skin beautification and anti-aging care (anti-aging), but its effects are attracting attention not only for aesthetic medicine but also for health and preventive medicine.

Main effect
  • Beautiful skin effect
  • allergic dermatitis
  • Improvement of wrinkles and sagging
  • insomnia
  • Improvement of thinning hair and hair loss
  • chronic fatigue
  • diabetes
  • infertility
  • osteoporosis

NMN drip

NMN is officially called "nicotinamide mononucleotide" and is expected to have anti-aging effects as a new generation anti-aging treatment. NMN is a vitamin-like substance that originally exists in living organisms and is produced naturally by the body. It plays an important role in repairing organs and tissues.
As we age, our body's production decreases, so taking it internally can help improve physical function and cognitive ability.

Main effect
  • Improvement of dementia
  • Improve concentration
  • recovery of athletic ability
  • Breathing becomes easier
  • sleep better
  • Improvement of wrinkles, sagging, and dullness
  • Improvement of neurological diseases, diabetes, functional disorders, obesity, etc.

Those who cannot receive treatment

Contraindications vary depending on the drug used, so please contact us for more information.

  • Those who are pregnant, may become pregnant, or are breastfeeding
  • People with drug hypersensitivity
  • Those using active vitamin D preparations
  • Those with G6PD deficiency (If you are unsure, we will guide you to a test)
  • People with severe heart failure
  • People with renal failure
  • Those with large amounts of pleural effusion or ascites
  • Those with acute pancreatitis/chronic pancreatitis

Precautions

downtime

  • You can resume your normal daily activities from the day of your treatment, including washing your face and applying makeup. However, please refrain from vigorously rubbing or massaging the injection site.
  • Internal bleeding may occur at the injection site, but this usually subsides within two weeks.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

In Japan, this product has not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act.

About the acquisition route

All items are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports

https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance. *This will be a free medical treatment.
